name: Victoria House
insider_take: Victoria House is a serene, upscale retreat on Ambergris Caye where barefoot luxury meets the world's second-largest barrier reef — a true jewel of the Caribbean.
whats_special: Nestled just 1.5 miles south of San Pedro Town, Victoria House sits along a pristine stretch of beach with direct access to Belize's legendary Mesoamerican Barrier Reef — a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The property blends colonial Caribbean charm with refined amenities, offering a range of accommodations from beachfront casitas to lavish plantation-style suites. With its own dive shop on-site, guests can slip beneath the turquoise waters to explore one of the most biodiverse reef systems on the planet, including the iconic Great Blue Hole.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise snorkel excursion directly through the hotel's dive center — the reef is noticeably quieter and more vibrant in the early morning hours before day-trippers arrive from the mainland.
dont_miss: Sip handcrafted cocktails at the overwater bar while watching the sunset paint the Caribbean sky, then dine at the beachside restaurant where locally caught seafood and Belizean flavors take center stage. A round at the resort's private pool, surrounded by lush tropical gardens, is the perfect way to unwind between reef adventures.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach
Elegant colonial-style architecture and sophisticated design
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Remote island location requires boat or small aircraft transfer
